profile: Separate hostile exact-delta, legacy-save, localization and ending-routing refutation
tier: CPU source/data and presentation-call text; no raster or physical output evaluation
nativeResolutionMeaning: Required no-raster sentinel; not a measured resolution.
verdictMeaning: Conservative critic default; no narrative-quality, blind, element or product approval. No concrete prose/routing defect survives this bounded review.
scoreMeaning: Required unscored sentinel, not a narrative or product score.
blindComparison: Not performed. Source-labelled text and CPU routing checks cannot establish an unlabelled reader preference, narrative quality, sensory quality, or an element/product pass.
scope: Independent exact source/data diff and old-save ending routing against the immutable R4 snapshot. Actual applySave/DialogueRunner/Director.finish/Storage; presentation is observed at menus.showEnding. Appearance/UI input acquisition/output devices are fixture stubs. Retained actual route replay is inspected, not repeated. No narrative-quality, sensory, blind, product or full-story-journey claim.
independence: Separate refuter used fresh scripts/results and only snapshot production imports. The legacy payload and route replay were read from retained evidence; the entire eight-case save/choice/finish/presentation matrix was independently executed. Live survival production modules were not imported, and no mechanical replay or prolonged reading simulation was added.
refutationOutcome: All requested concrete consistency and routing controls survive. No new route flag, content condition, identifier, or quality criterion was introduced by the reviewed delta.

controlsRefutation.attempt: Challenged the possibility that masking named changes concealed a behavioral/content-routing edit. Independently compared every snapshot production source against the baseline and computed generic recursive exported-value differences without masking values.
controlsRefutation.conclusion: Only the two English beat texts, corresponding two Japanese beat strings and one Japanese notice differ as exported data. Removing precisely the two added comment lines and reversing the one English notice literal makes Director byte-identical to baseline. All other production src hashes match baseline, including the route/save conditions and identifiers.

controlsRefutation.attempt: Checked whether the updated notice was merely a source literal never selected by real routing, and whether the input replay used simulated perception or a different route flag.

controlsRefutation.conclusion: Eight actual applySave -> final DialogueRunner callbacks -> authored available choice -> Director.finish -> menus.showEnding cases succeed. Flag-present saves select the correct new paragraph exactly once; flag-absent controls select it zero times. Removing the paragraph from the flag-present body exactly reproduces its paired flag-absent body, and paired epilogues are identical. Wrong-ending paragraphs and the old replaced paragraphs are absent; Japanese output is checked directly against authored Japanese strings and cannot pass via English fallback. Every restored flag persists into the completed save.
controlsRefutation.limits: The absence control removes only trench_slipped from a copy of the generated valid payload to test its condition; it is not a claimed complete alternate authored journey. Ending callbacks advance no simulation time, so this does not evaluate dialogue survival, death/reset, presentation timing, rendered layout or physical audio.

consistencyAssessment.status: no concrete contradiction found in the changed prose within reviewed scope
consistencyAssessment.englishAndJapaneseMeaning: The notice describes crossing the line and reaching higher ground. The record beat describes marking that physical route on a section drawing at the hearing. The everybody beat describes that route and helping evacuees board lorries. Neither English nor Japanese changed text asserts that no guard detected Ren or that nobody was touched/hurt.
consistencyAssessment.existingRoutingMeaning: Both ending beats still use only condition {flag:trench_slipped}; the route flag remains a positional record and carries no new stealth or no-harm criterion.
consistencyAssessment.limit: This is a concrete consistency/routing observation, not an assessment that the new prose is more compelling or an independently verified account of all future narrative events.
